face.name: 奥术畸体
face.text: 在你施放一个法术后，使本随从获得+1生命值。
face.flavorText: 他原本是一个时空畸体，在厌倦了两极颠倒的生活后变成了现在这个模样。

face.name: Arcane Anomaly
face.text: After you cast a spell, give this minion +1 Health.
face.flavorText: He used to get work as a Spatial Anomaly, but he got tired of having his polarity reversed.

face.name: 失心农夫
face.text: 每当本随从攻击时，对敌方英雄造成2点伤害。
face.flavorText: 要是让你去永久冻土层上耕地，你也会失心疯的。

face.name: Wretched Tiller
face.text: Whenever this minion attacks, deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.
face.flavorText: If you ever tried to plow permafrost, you’d be wretched, too.

face.name: 无私的英雄
face.text: 亡语：随机使一个友方随从获得圣盾。
face.flavorText: “别担心，即便我倒下了，也会祝福你们。向着胜利……前进！”

face.name: Selfless Hero
face.text: Deathrattle: Give a random friendly minion Divine Shield.
face.flavorText: "Don't worry about me… I'll just be here... under these tentacles."

face.name: 恩佐斯的副官
face.text: 战吼：装备一把1/3的锈蚀铁钩。
face.flavorText: 作为副官成天被呼来喝去真是不胜其烦，可谁让恩佐斯是他的老板呢。

face.name: N'Zoth's First Mate
face.text: Battlecry: Equip a 1/3 Rusty Hook.
face.flavorText: Hates when N'Zoth yells "Ahoy Matey!!", but there's not really much he can do about it.

face.name: 暗鳞先知
face.text: 你的其他鱼人拥有+1攻击力。
face.flavorText: 这些算是有头脑的鱼人。但仍然有些名不副实。

face.name: Grimscale Oracle
face.text: Your other Murlocs have +1 Attack.
face.flavorText: These are the brainy murlocs. It turns out that doesn’t mean much.

face.name: 鱼人招潮者
face.text: 每当你召唤一个鱼人，便获得 +1攻击力。
face.flavorText: 每当他和他的家人团聚时，这个家伙会变得特别厉害。

face.name: Murloc Tidecaller
face.text: Whenever you summon a Murloc, gain +1 Attack.
face.flavorText: This guy gets crazy strong at family reunions.

face.name: 蹩脚海盗
face.text: 如果你装备着武器，本随从拥有 +2攻击力。
face.flavorText: 看在你块头比我大的份上，今天暂且放过你！

face.name: Small-Time Buccaneer
face.text: Has +2 Attack while you have a weapon equipped.
face.flavorText: "Oh, I'm not serious about it. I only pirate on the weekends."

face.name: 齿轮大师
face.text: 如果你控制任何机械，便拥有 +2攻击力。
face.flavorText: 片刻之后，你看到的不再是齿轮和链条，它们可能变成了机器人、蜘蛛坦克、射线发射器和其他各种各样的装置……

face.name: Cogmaster
face.text: Has +2 Attack while you have a Mech.
face.flavorText: After a while, you don't see the cogs and sprockets. All you see is a robot, a spider tank, a deathray...

face.name: 古拉巴什供品
face.text: 在你的回合开始时，消灭本随从，并获得 8点护甲值。
face.flavorText: 供品限时特惠，一次献祭，双倍祝福（受益人仅限祭品本人）！

face.name: Gurubashi Offering
face.text: At the start of your turn, destroy this and gain 8 Armor.
face.flavorText: For a limited time, loa blessings are on a pray-one-get-two deal (on selected sacrifices only).

face.name: 恒金巡游者
face.text: 每当本随从受到伤害，获得2点护甲值。
face.flavorText: 你以为他在对你点头微笑？你在他眼里不过是一堆人形废铁罢了。

face.name: Eternium Rover
face.text: Whenever this minion takes damage, gain 2 Armor.
face.flavorText: He's all beeps and smiles but you're just a walking pile of armor to him.

past_scope: Historical one-cost candidates for real Standard past sources; membership and duplicate print weights remain unverified. No production past domain is bound.
selfless_constructed_policy: Use the existing random keyword producer on all live friendly minions, including a currently shielded recipient. This is an explicit internal Constructed policy, not a CN-certified selector. The official 16.0.8 exclusion is explicitly Battlegrounds and is not transferred to Constructed.
